title: Wan Animate 2
description: Character animation: your character (a picture) performs the motion of a driving video. The background and camera come from the prompt.

labels.672:582:text: Describe the character and the background
labels.672:585:text: Describe the motion and the camera

hints: The character keeps the look of its picture; the background is made from the prompt, not from the picture or the video.
A clear, full-body driving video with one person works best.
